info.name: Ouvira ERP API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Ouvira ERP backend API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Import Ouvira_ERP.postman_environment.json
3. Run Auth / Login — tokens auto-saved
4. All authenticated requests use {{access_token}}

## What's new (recruitment-gaps-implementation)
- Approval flow timeline endpoint
- Bulk actions (approve/reject/delete/publish/close/edit)
- Import CVs from Excel/CSV
- Sync from job boards (placeholder)
- Audit log endpoints per entity type
- Post-probation evaluation workflow
- Multi-field filtering on all list endpoints
- job_board, call_status, offer_validity_date fields
- Per-interviewer scoring schema

item.name: Recruitment — Hiring Requests
item.description:
Hiring request CRUD + workflow + bulk actions + approval flow timeline.
Filters: ?department=&status=&job_title=&created_by=

item.name: Recruitment — Job Advertisements
item.description:
Job ad CRUD + workflow + bulk actions.
Filters: ?status=&city=&area=&platforms=&deadline_before=&deadline_after=

body.raw:
{
  "hiring_request": {{hiring_request_id}},
  "title": "Senior Backend Engineer",
  "description": "We are looking for a senior backend engineer.",
  "requirements": "5+ years Python experience",
  "skills": ["Python", "Django", "PostgreSQL"],
  "responsibilities": "Design and implement APIs",
  "city": "Cairo",
  "area": "Nasr City",
  "deadline": "2026-06-30",

}

item.name: Recruitment — Job Applications
item.description:
Application CRUD + pipeline + bulk edit + import + sync.
Filters: ?status=&classification=&job_board=&job_advertisement=&candidate=

formdata.description: Excel or CSV file. Required columns: name/first_name+last_name, email. Optional: phone, linkedin_url, source, classification, cv_link

item.name: Recruitment — Documents
item.description: Candidate document upload and verification. doc_type: id_copy, qualification, military_status, personal_photo, police_clearance, birth_certificate (GAP-09), other

formdata.description: id_copy | qualification | military_status | personal_photo | police_clearance | birth_certificate | other

item.name: Recruitment — Job Offers
item.description: Job offer CRUD + accept/decline. New field: offer_validity_date (GAP-08).

body.raw:
{
  "application": {{application_id}},
  "salary": "25000.00",
  "allowance": "2000.00",
  "benefits": "Health insurance, annual leave",
  "start_date": "2026-07-01",
  "offer_validity_date": "2026-06-15",
  "note": "Please respond within 7 days"
}

item.name: Recruitment — Onboarding
item.description: Onboarding with structured fields (GAP-11): session_date, session_location, assigned_mentor, attended, engagement_level (1-5), survey_link, survey_responses.

item.name: Recruitment — Post-Probation Evaluation
item.description:
Multi-step approval workflow (GAP-12): draft -> submitted_to_manager -> manager_approved -> hr_confirmed -> final_decision.
Scores: tasks, attendance, initiative, collaboration, teamwork (each 1-5). average_score auto-computed.

item.name: Recruitment — Audit Logs
item.description:
Read-only audit trail scoped to recruitment entities (GAP-05).
Filters: ?action_type=&performed_by=&from_date=&to_date=&search=
Paginated: ?page=&page_size= (default 10)
